scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Additional Incentive for Adventure Tour Operators
other_conditions: Project must be set up on or after 22 February 2021, or eligible hotel units that started commercial operation between 7 January 2015 and 31 December 2020 but could not apply under the previous scheme due to absence of a Bar in the hotel.
Units may be in the private sector, co‑operative sector, joint sector, or owned/managed by the State Government.
Project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose.
Project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank, or State Financial Institution.
Unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate, and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited.
benefits_summary: Provides an additional incentive ranging from 60% to 100% reimbursement for purchase of tents, dinghies, adventure and sports equipment, based on the unit’s category and location.
